description: Approved venture-fund closes, newest first: fund, manager, close_type (launch, target, first, interim, final, unspecified), date, amount and currency as announced, source. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: since / until (YYYY-MM-DD), close_type, fintech_focus, limit. Without close_type only first, interim and final closes are listed. Unknown arguments are rejected.
name: list_fund_closes
title: List fund closes
